rationale: RELABEL 2026-10-24 (extended vocabulary, Lead-ruled; the svelte precedent): the SFC template component-tag emission is `renders`, not `instantiates` — the host renderer mounts the component and no `new` exists in the source (types.ts Renders contract). This fixture's template-tag pins were converted `instantiates`->`renders` with every other field byte-identical; historical measurement counts inside this rationale still name the label they were measured under. V2 (#419): template expressions ({{ count }}, :label="label", @click="onSave", v-model="count", v-if="show") read script-side members — the template<->script data-flow must emit Uses edges from the component to those members. Pre-fix: the template pass emitted only instantiates for component tags; every member binding was silent.
